families.title: C direct IPv4 TCP
families.observation_source: Trusted observer удерживает C process/token/image handle; independent WFP decision + scoped owned receiver с run nonce.
families.expected: Попытка действительно инициирована C; коррелируемый deny выбранной boundary; ноль nonce receipts.
families.negative_control: В заведомо изолированной lab разрешённый контроль observer/receiver и намеренно отсутствующий lab deny должны выявить неверный oracle; bypass разрешён только при доказанном outer containment.
families.false_pass_risk: Timeout, неверный target, не запущенный процесс или недоступный receiver выглядят как block.
families.preparation_rollback: Заранее согласованные disposable endpoints; после пробы quiesce C, keep-deny, без реального DIRECT из рабочей Windows.

families.title: B exact physical upstream
families.observation_source: Independent socket→held process→primary B token/image observer и remote controlled upstream receipt; logical CONNECT receipt отдельно.
families.expected: Один approved R:Q TCP socket реально принадлежит B engine; nonce/payload у owned upstream, без UI delegation.
families.negative_control: B-wrapper с U-owned engine и CONNECT200 без downstream receipt должны провалить owner/route oracle.
families.false_pass_risk: CONNECT200, PID reuse, sampled socket table или TLS session cache ошибочно принимаются за B egress.
families.preparation_rollback: Только lab-approved engine/source и dummy auth после secret safety review; никакого real tunnel; остановить owned tree, закрыть flows.

families.title: B wrong address/port/alternate proxy
families.observation_source: B initiation/token evidence + effective tuple policy observer + controlled forbidden receivers.
families.expected: Каждый wrong-IP/wrong-port/secondary proxy tuple отклонён; нет receipts или альтернативного socket owner.
families.negative_control: Внутри outer-contained lab intentional wrong-tuple filter mutant должен быть обнаружен downstream observer.
families.false_pass_risk: Receiver down, неверный IP family или движок сам отказал до системного фильтра.
families.preparation_rollback: Тестовый бинарник/набор tuple утверждены отдельно; scoped receipts; quiesce до cleanup.

families.title: Upstream loss/retries/redirect/env
families.observation_source: Owned upstream fault controller, monotonic attempt log, independent all C/B scoped flow observer и effective policy.
families.expected: После отказа/timeout/reset/redirect/NO_PROXY/env попытки остаются только approved edge; нет DIRECT/DNS/secondary route.
families.negative_control: Изолированный fallback mutant с controlled alternate receiver должен дать FAIL даже при исходном CONNECT error.
families.false_pass_risk: Короткое окно скрывает delayed retry, DNS/health dial или reconnect после восстановления.
families.preparation_rollback: Fault injection только lab endpoint; bounded retries+grace window из source review; keep-deny при восстановлении.

families.title: IPv6 / mapped / transition
families.observation_source: Initiator token + address-family/tuple observer, V4/V6 classification evidence и owned dual-stack receivers.
families.expected: C/B ::1, IPv6 external, IPv4-mapped и доступные transition paths не создают неутверждённый egress.
families.negative_control: Изолированный V6 deny omission mutant выявляется; positive observer control на отдельной lab role.
families.false_pass_risk: IPv6 disabled или отсутствует route: NOT TESTABLE, а не подтверждённый WFP deny.
families.preparation_rollback: Не включать IPv6 на рабочей Windows; поддержка family предварительно согласуется для lab; затем quiesce.

families.title: DNS and delegated resolver
families.observation_source: Scoped C/B attempts + independent resolver/service delegation observer + owned DNS/DoH/DoT receivers.
families.expected: Нет unapproved resolution ни от C/B, ни от делегированного U/SYSTEM service.
families.negative_control: Cache-busting nonce и deliberately delegated resolver mutant должны выявить обход SID-only coverage.
families.false_pass_risk: Cache hit/hosts file скрывает сетевой DNS, а наблюдение только C/B пропускает DNS Client service.
families.preparation_rollback: Синтетические имена и owned DNS только под отдельным network GO; не менять host DNS/V2Ray; dispose lab.

families.title: UDP/raw/secondary protocols
families.observation_source: Actual protocol capability/attempt observer + filter classification + owned protocol receivers.
families.expected: Никакого необъявленного UDP/ICMP/raw/secondary path; неподдерживаемые probes отдельно NOT TESTABLE.
families.negative_control: UDP omission mutant в outer-contained lab должен зарегистрироваться receiver, а не остаться зелёным.
families.false_pass_risk: Privilege error при raw socket creation принимается за сетевой фильтр; UDP silence за deny.
families.preparation_rollback: Не повышать права для текущей TASK; будущий GO задаёт разрешённые протоколы; quiesce/keep-deny.

families.title: Unauthorized NPFS peer / pipe squatting
families.observation_source: Gateway access/peer decision fixed code, kernel pipe peer PID→held token/image handle, independent worker invocation counter.
families.expected: Wrong SID, same-SID wrong image, remote pipe и precreated fake server отвергнуты; SDK не запущен для запроса.
families.negative_control: ACL-only или SID-only peer mutant в lab обязан пропустить controlled adversary и вызвать FAIL.
families.false_pass_risk: Gateway не работает/нет pipe; отказ не из-за auth; PID/image race или broad access mask.
families.preparation_rollback: Disposable exact pipe names и dummy grant; без реальных secrets; закрыть pipe/job/handles и проверить отсутствие child.

families.title: Config/source tamper and TOCTOU
families.observation_source: Trusted controller preimage/pins + file ACL/reparse/replacement observer + actual launcher admission and process count.
families.expected: Модификация после preflight/смена parent/reparse/merge/env/reload => no Resume; никаких network attempts.
families.negative_control: Pin-check omission или writable-parent mutant должен дать controlled launch и FAIL oracle.
families.false_pass_risk: Повторное чтение того же caller pin, вместо trusted controller; disk hash не равен mapped executable.
families.preparation_rollback: Только lab copy, никакого рабочего config; restore owned preimage compare-and-swap, keep admissions frozen.

families.title: Auth/407/error/log secret boundary
families.observation_source: Dummy unique canaries; independent enumeration permitted diagnostic sinks/crash/argv/env channels; auth handler receipt.
families.expected: Missing/empty/wrong auth отклонён; canary secret/header absent in every agreed sink, including upstream error chain.
families.negative_control: Canary-leaking logger mutant обязан детектироваться; пустые/несобранные sinks => INCOMPLETE.
families.false_pass_risk: Redaction маскирует исходную утечку, incomplete sinks, real credential ошибочно попал в evidence.
families.preparation_rollback: Только dummy credentials после source fix/review; реальный upstream secret blocker не снят; sanitized counts, raw canary fixture приватен в lab.

families.title: Recovery / deny removal / UI preservation
families.observation_source: Independent lifecycle+queued-work/flow/handle observer, exact owned filter/ACL readback before/after; agreed U baseline.
families.expected: Deny не удаляется до zero-work, startup frozen; recovery не меняет U proxy и не resurrect C/B.
families.negative_control: Forged ledger zero, surviving child/flow и чужой object key должны дать KEEP DENY, не cleanup.
families.false_pass_risk: PID list/ledger заменяет real quiescence; global reset чинит lab ценой ослабления host.
families.preparation_rollback: Out-of-band recovery и scoped preimages до setup; only exact owned rollback, unknown => keep-deny/escalate.

families.title: Children / alternate token / delegated helper
families.observation_source: Held process ancestry/primary tokens, job handles, independent flow owner and delegated work observation.
families.expected: Same-SID children restricted; undeclared image suspended/rejected; token/delegation/handle escape не даёт U egress.
families.negative_control: Image-only filter или broker wrapper delegating U engine должен дать FAIL.
families.false_pass_risk: Job kill-on-close ошибочно принят за сетевой sandbox; snapshots пропускают короткоживущий helper.
families.preparation_rollback: Только disposable binaries и controlled U helper; no SeDebug grant; stop entire owned tree and delegated queues.

families.title: Loopback exact port / B listener owner
families.observation_source: Local listen/accept owner token+image, bind exclusivity, client auth and independent flow policy observer.
families.expected: Wrong port, ::1, fake/rebound U listener и non-B listener не приняты; C exception не расширяется.
families.negative_control: Correct tuple but wrong listener owner должен провалить gate даже при CONNECT200.
families.false_pass_risk: Tuple-only ALE check ошибочно приписывает порт B, process reuse и bind race.
families.preparation_rollback: Только если выбран loopback transport; no рабочие ports; stop client before server cleanup, keep-deny.

families.title: Crash / reboot / BFE/provider loss
families.observation_source: Out-of-band boot/lifecycle observer + effective persistent-policy readback before admission + controlled receiver.
families.expected: C/B не Resume в gap и после policy loss; reboot не превращает отсутствие controller в разрешение.
families.negative_control: Startup-before-policy mutant должен дать FAIL; nonpersistent omission в disposable lab обнаруживается.
families.false_pass_risk: PERSISTENT flag принимается за boot-time enforcement; probe начинается после опасного окна.
families.preparation_rollback: Отдельный GO на reboot/service fault в lab, никогда рабочую BFE; independent outer containment and recovery до fault.

families.title: Existing flow / inherited socket handle
families.observation_source: Trusted handle inheritance inventory, admission ordering, scoped flow lifecycle observer и owned receiver.
families.expected: Нет pre-policy established flow или duplicated foreign socket у C/B; rollback waits for all references.
families.negative_control: Intentionally inherited already-connected lab socket должен выявить gap connect-time-only policy.
families.false_pass_risk: Новые connect blocked, но existing socket продолжает data; table sampling теряет ownership handoff.
families.preparation_rollback: Existing-flow preparation только под separate native GO в containment; close all duplicates, zero-work proof.

families.title: Cross-SID NPFS authorized positive path
families.observation_source: Kernel peer token/SID/image both directions + exact DACL readback + fixed read-only synthetic MCP nonce/receipt.
families.expected: Correct C↔U peer работает с minimal query rights и Identification-only; no SeDebug/admin/C token leakage.
families.negative_control: Wrong client/server SID и higher impersonation variant отвергнуты; no grant/token inheritance.
families.false_pass_risk: Same-user fixture выдаётся за cross-user pass; helper получает U rights; отсутствие receiver контроля.
families.preparation_rollback: Отдельный launcher/ACL scope и dummy grants; MCP receipt read-only synthetic; stop job/pipe before cleanup. Generic egress oracle здесь НЕ применяется.

families.title: Logical CONNECT target vs physical upstream
families.observation_source: Native handler parsed authority/method/auth observer + physical B R:Q owner and owned logical destination receipt.
families.expected: CONNECT other D/port, Upgrade/plain/UoT denied, даже если physical R:Q allowed.
families.negative_control: Allow-all CONNECT parser mutant обязан FAIL; metadata JSON и HTTP200 сами по себе недостаточны.
families.false_pass_risk: Только transport socket проверен; логическая DNS/UDP операция зашифрована внутри allowed TCP.
families.preparation_rollback: Lab dummy protocol endpoints после source compatibility review; no OpenAI/tunnel; quiesce owned processes.

families.title: Rollback object ownership / concurrency
families.observation_source: Trusted preimage + exact provider/filter/ACL/account ownership readback, independent drift and quiescence observer.
families.expected: Concurrent replacement, foreign reference/key, preexisting account => STOP/KEEP DENY; не remove-by-name.
families.negative_control: Forged UUID/ledger или account-name-only deleter должен дать FAIL на controlled foreign lab object.
families.false_pass_risk: Successful delete по неверному объекту маскирует damage; snapshot restore затирает чужой change.
families.preparation_rollback: Только disposable lab owned and controlled decoy objects; no global import/reset; preserve evidence and escalate.
